clue.text: Comedian may appear wild in play

definitions.meaning: a funny person, a clown or wit
in card games the extra card of the pack can count as a wild card

explanation.surface: A stand-up turns up in a stage play and goes wild.
explanation.definitionFit: A comic is often called by this name, and in card play the same card serves as a wild one.

clue.text: Judge has wrongdoer beheaded: difficult part of sentence to pronounce

definitions.text: difficult part of sentence to pronounce

indicators.note: beheaded says the first letter of the word for wrongdoer is removed

parts.note: a lawbreaker is a criminal or wrongdoer

explanation.surface: A judge sentences a criminal to beheading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sentence' suggests the judge passing sentence; here it is a sentence of words.
explanation.definitionFit: A long, tongue-twisting word that is hard to say is so called, as if it might break your jaw.

clue.text: Drink Church of Scotland finally banned

indicators.note: finally banned says the last letter of the Scottish church word is removed

parts.note: the Kirk is the Church of Scotland

explanation.surface: The Scottish church finally outlaws alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Kir is a French drink of white wine with blackcurrant liqueur.

clue.text: Awfully severe officials

indicators.note: awfully says the letters of severe are badly arranged

explanation.surface: Some officials are dreadfully strict.
explanation.definitionFit: In medieval England these were local officials or magistrates, as the shire officers were.

clue.text: Pour wine to accompany an hors d'oeuvre selection

indicators.note: to accompany puts the following pieces alongside the little word an, after it

parts.note: to tip a jug is to pour from it
Asti is a sparkling Italian wine

explanation.surface: Serve the wine alongside a plate of starters.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian word names a mixed plate of starters served before the main meal, the Italian equivalent of hors d'oeuvres.

clue.text: Wit observed in Room At The Top and The Ancient Mariner

parts.note: an attic is the room at the top of a house; also a novel title
an old salt is an ancient sailor

explanation.surface: Wit spotted in a famous novel and a famous poem.
explanation.walkthrough: The italic titles are a novel and Coleridge's poem; read them literally.
explanation.definitionFit: Attic salt is refined, elegant wit, from the dry humour of ancient Athens.

clue.text: Row of houses not making use of church land

indicators.note: not making use of says the church letters are left out

parts.note: a terrace is a row of joined houses
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A street of houses that doesn't use church land.
explanation.definitionFit: Terra is Latin for earth or land, used in English phrases.

clue.text: Performers principally featured in pin-ups?

definitions.meaning: the people whose posters usually decorate teenage bedroom walls

explanation.surface: Entertainers who mainly appear on pin-up posters.
explanation.definitionFit: Famous chart singers are performers and also the usual subjects of pin-up posters.

clue.text: Son and I go wrong, lacking escorts round east African republic

parts.note: to err is to go wrong

indicators.note: round puts the word for lacking escorts about the letter for east

parts.note: someone without escorts is alone

explanation.surface: A father admits he and his son went astray in Africa without guides.
explanation.definitionFit: This West African country, capital Freetown, is a republic.

clue.text: Extract from quite moving article

indicators.note: Extract from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An excerpt from a rather touching newspaper piece.
explanation.definitionFit: An item is a single article, in a list or a newspaper.

clue.text: Rejected argument about secret manoeuvres in Chinatown

indicators.note: something rejected is thrown back, so the word for argument is read backwards

parts.note: a row is a quarrel or argument

indicators.note: manoeuvres says the letters of secret are moved around

explanation.surface: A row about secret moves in an Asian district of some city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Chinatown' reads as the district; split it as 'China town', a town famous for porcelain. 'about' is only a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: The English city of Worcester is famous for its fine porcelain, so it is literally a china town.

clue.text: Musical composition for king or queen?

definitions.meaning: a work of music, such as a piano work
king and queen are each a chessman, the general word for which is the same

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a royal should have music written in their honour.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a musical work and also any chessman, such as the king or queen.

clue.text: Fairground attraction local resort developed with hesitation

indicators.note: a resort that is developed is reshaped, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: er is the sound of a speaker hesitating

explanation.surface: A local seaside resort hesitantly builds a fairground ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developed' rearranges LOCALRESORT together with ER, which lands in the middle of the result.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the classic fairground ride of climbs and plunges on a track.

clue.text: In escaping, a soldier once observing the courtesies?

indicators.note: In says the following pieces go inside the word for escaping

parts.note: gas or water escaping is leaking
a vet, short for veteran, is someone who was once a soldier

explanation.surface: An old soldier, while fleeing, still remembers his manners.
explanation.walkthrough: VET is the American short form for veteran, a former soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying a polite goodbye is one of the courtesies, so the farewell observes them.

clue.text: One who hotfoots it in the cause of religion

definitions.text: One who hotfoots it in the cause of religion

parts.words: One who hotfoots it in the cause of religion
parts.note: hotfoots usually means hurrying, but here read literally: someone whose feet get hot crossing embers as a religious rite

explanation.definitionFit: Some religious devotees walk barefoot over hot stones or embers as an act of faith.

clue.text: A knave's spoken of as a war hero

indicators.note: spoken of says the words are heard rather than read

parts.note: a knave is a jack in a pack of cards, so A knave's is heard as a jacks

explanation.surface: A rogue is described as a military hero.
explanation.definitionFit: He is one of the great Greek warriors at Troy in Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: Conductor's gibe, one repeated about drummer's performance?

parts.note: a barb is a cutting remark

indicators.note: about puts the pair of ones round the drumming word
repeated says the numeral for one appears twice

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a drum roll is a drummer's rapid beating

explanation.surface: A jibe at a conductor, aimed again at the drummer's playing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conductor's' means 'Conductor is'. Sir John Barbirolli was a British conductor, long at the Hallé Orchestra.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir John was a celebrated English orchestral conductor of the twentieth century.

clue.text: Below the summit, almost captures British beast

indicators.note: Below in a down clue puts the next part under the summit word

parts.note: the brow of a hill is its top

indicators.note: captures says the word for almost holds the British letter

parts.note: near means almost

explanation.surface: Just below the hilltop, a creature nearly catches a Briton.
explanation.definitionFit: This large animal is a kind of bear found across the northern forests.

clue.text: Before operation doctor allows small amounts of liquid

indicators.note: Before says the doctor is placed ahead of the operation

parts.note: lets means allows

explanation.surface: Before surgery the doctor permits a few sips of water.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny drops of liquid are called this, a diminutive of drops.

clue.text: Cursing allowance given to member of the board?

indicators.note: given to says the allowance is joined on after the board member

parts.note: an exec is an executive who may sit on a company board
a ration is a fixed allowance

explanation.surface: A board director is handed a fixed allowance.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means a curse or the act of uttering curses, a solemn damning.

clue.text: Bird plunged in the Grand Canyon

definitions.meaning: a pigeon-like bird, symbol of peace
Americans, as in Arizona, use this as the past tense of dive

explanation.surface: A bird plummeted into the Grand Canyon.
explanation.walkthrough: Plunged means dived; the Grand Canyon points to the American form.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a peaceful bird and the American past tense of to dive.

clue.text: Sank golf ball thus, so to speak? Hang on a minute

indicators.note: so to speak says the words are said aloud

parts.note: to sink a putt is to have holed it

explanation.surface: A golfer sank a ball and asks for a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: Hold it is a spoken request to wait or stop for a moment.

clue.text: In another language, vowels are the most important element

definitions.meaning: in Greek the first and last letters of the alphabet are both vowels
the beginning and end of everything, the essential whole

explanation.surface: In a foreign tongue the vowels matter most of all.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical phrase means the beginning and end, hence the essential, most vital part.

clue.text: Female in shortened version of ET, a well-known film

indicators.note: in puts the female letter inside the shortened word
shortened version of says the last letter is cut off

parts.note: ET, the film's extraterrestrial, is an alien

explanation.surface: A woman features in a cut version of the film ET.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortened version of' cuts ALIEN to ALIE; Alfie is the 1966 Michael Caine film.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1966 film starring Michael Caine is famous, and was remade in 2004.

clue.text: Chief European space station

parts.note: Mir was the Russian space station

explanation.surface: Europe's main space station.
explanation.definitionFit: An emir is a Muslim ruler or chieftain.

clue.text: Crop of the month, might one say?

indicators.note: might one say says the word is heard spoken

parts.note: the month of May gives May's, belonging to that month

explanation.surface: A farmer asks which crop is in season this month.
explanation.definitionFit: This cereal crop is also called corn or sweetcorn.

clue.text: Weird folk organised research activity

indicators.note: organised says these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Strange people set up some kind of study project.
explanation.definitionFit: Research done out in the real world rather than in a lab or library goes by this name.

clue.text: Stale portions of roulade regularly rejected

indicators.note: regularly rejected says every other letter of roulade is thrown out, keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: Bits of the roulade went stale and were sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop R, U, A, E of roulade; the remaining letters spell the answer. 'portions of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread that is old is stale, no longer fresh.

clue.text: Dance director seen about with soldiers by back-streets of Paris

parts.note: re means about or concerning
GIs are American soldiers

indicators.note: back says the French word for streets is read backwards

parts.note: rue is French for street, so rues are the streets of Paris

explanation.surface: A ballet director is spotted with troops in the back-streets of Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back-streets' looks like one word; 'back' turns RUES into SEUR.
explanation.definitionFit: In ballet this French term is used for the person who stages and directs the production.

clue.text: Short path winding round rear of detached house

indicators.note: round puts the turned path about the last letter of detached
winding says the shortened path turns back on itself
short says the last letter of the word for path is cut

parts.note: a route is a path or way

indicators.note: rear of picks the final letter of detached

explanation.surface: A shortened driveway curves round behind a detached house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' cuts ROUTE to ROUT, 'winding' turns it to TUOR, and 'round' wraps it about D. 'house' means a royal dynasty, not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudors were the English royal house of Henry VIII and Elizabeth I.
